scope: Read-only CPU actual native snapshots; static counterfactual target clocks/scopes explicitly differ; no GPU, no synthetic contact/pose/force
baseline_frames: For each predeclared env0 trace: uniform16 endpoints plus first candidate for each finger and first wrong target; at most24 unique endpoints in ascending actual time. No pilot input.
counterfactual: Repeat each immutable actual q/body/force snapshot for compiled67 original targets. Each row scopes only one original note and uses its audible midpoint. Do not invent string/fret/finger/onset/end.
selection: First qualifying source in source_order; within source earliest actual time then lowest original target index; retain unavailable if no case found in declared scope

cases.far: assigned pad distance>=20mm and candidate=false; record load separately
cases.own_wrong_string: current own_wrong_string provenance true, assigned positive=false, candidate=false
cases.own_wrong_fret: current own_wrong_fret provenance true, assigned positive=false, candidate=false
cases.other_finger_only: assigned positive=false; another loaded facing distal pad has exact target string+fret; candidate=false; wrong may correctly remain false for same/lower fret
cases.other_higher: current other_higher provenance true; separately state whether assigned positive=true so competing veto is demonstrated
cases.back_facing: assigned body loaded>=0.01N, at least one SAME pad sample passes cell/lateral/height, but all such valid pad samples fail facing cos>=0.1; no artificial dorsal patch
cases.near_unloaded: assigned facing geometry true but body resultant<0.01N and candidate=false (optional nonpenalty control)
cases.short_contact: prefer actual-ledger episode final0<contact_progress<1 and noachievement; else label static segment0<streak<tau50ms only, without payment claim; partial progress reward is allowed
cases.release: actual240Hz commanded release phase: candidate true→false and positive_before_wrong false at next endpoint; label geometric candidate release, not certified pair contact detachment

evidence: sourcefile SHA, row/env, actual physics tick/time, source target ID, diagnostic target ID/time/scope, native body force and independently recomputed same-point/positive/wrong witnesses
unavailable_policy: absence only within declared stored sample scope; no pose synthesis, target invention, relaxed pass rules, music success or causal contact-pair claim
